$comment: GitHub and the board: a pull request named in a task shows its state on the row; work an issue as a task; promote a row.
do: caption:The board follows GitHub|A pull request named in a task shows its state on the row.
caption:Work an issue as a task|The issue stays in GitHub. The work happens here.
fill:Add a task…=Fix tax rounding on receipts github.com/coffee-shop/web/issues/118 @coder

eval:(() => { const c = document.querySelector('[data-testid="thread-conversation"]'); if (!c) return; let n = c; while (n && !/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(n).overflowY)) n = n.parentElement; if (!n) return; const go = () => n.scrollTo({ top: n.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' }); go(); new MutationObserver(go).observe(c, { childList: true, subtree: true }); })()
caption:The coder names its PR in the task|and the row picks it up.
zoom:text=Fix tax rounding on receipts >> nth=0@1.6
caption:CI running, awaiting review, approved, merged|The row keeps up on its own.
caption:Merged, resolved, and the issue closes in GitHub
caption:Promote what should outlive the room|File the issue in GitHub, then press p on the row.
